body: Orchestrator (2026-11-18): npm audit cannot be fixed in PR #45 — all 15 findings are advisory GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (picomatch ReDoS, every version <= 4.0.7; 4.0.7 is the latest published, first_patched_version null), reached only through dev/build tooling. `npm audit fix --force` would downgrade vitest to 3.1.4 and still not clear it. The person decided: merge PR #45 with the audit check failing, as main already would; DM-712 stays open for when a patched picomatch ships. Merge waits for PR #45's remaining CI (Fireguard shards).
